headword: {卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}

definitions.explanation: A market where goods, especially fresh produce, fish, and meat, are sold in bulk to retailers and restaurants rather than directly to consumers.

examples.japanese: {築地|つきじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だった。
examples.english: Tsukiji was famous as a wholesale market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧、{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{新鮮|しんせん}→新鮮：03261_shinsen⟧な⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧。
examples.english: Every morning, I stock up on fresh fish at the wholesale market.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}→地方自治体：19063_chihoujichitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧し、{食|しょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}えている→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧。
examples.english: Central wholesale markets are managed by local governments and support food safety.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧ (wholesale) + ⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (market). In Japan, ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう} (central wholesale markets) are public markets regulated by law, handling the distribution of perishable foods. The most famous example is the former {築地|つきじ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧, which moved to {豊洲|とよす} in 2018.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{中央|ちゅうおう}→中央：03475_chuuou⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}: central wholesale market
- ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}: regional wholesale market
- {卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕入|しい}れる→仕入れる：11430_shiireru⟧: to stock up at a wholesale market
- ⟦{青果|せいか}→青果：14825_seika⟧{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}: fruit and vegetable wholesale market

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧: wholesale — the broader concept of selling goods in bulk
- ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧: retail market — where goods are sold directly to consumers
- ⟦{朝市|あさいち}→朝市：13008_asaichi⟧: morning market — a public market open early in the morning, often for retail
